item.title: Why Experimental Details Matter: Recovering from a Flawed Interpretability Study
item.description: A striking interpretability result was frozen in public git before it ran and still came from a flawed comparison. We trace how prompt echo, a domain-mismatched lexicon, and unequal stakes produced an overconfident story; retract the invalid chart; and show how a corrected, frozen re-run changed what the experiment could support.

item.title: Open-sourcing (and Auditing) a Jacobian Lens for Qwen3.5-397B
item.description: Praxagent is open-sourcing a Jacobian lens for Qwen3.5-397B-A17B, fitted on 24 WikiText prompts. As of July 10, 2026, to our knowledge no public Jacobian lens has been fitted for a larger base model. A pre-registered readout audit against identity and random-J controls is included, with weights, hash, code and receipts.
